title: DNA-PKcs phosphorylates hnRNP-A1 to facilitate the RPA-to-POT1 switch and telomere capping after replication

grounded.context: general mammalian cells, cited from other work
grounded.evidence_quote: When replication forks stall, the extension of single-stranded DNA and the coating of RPA trigger activation of ataxia-telangiectasia and Rad3-related (ATR) kinase and DDR (4,5).

grounded.context: mammals, persistent RPA-coated ssDNA filaments, cited from other work
grounded.evidence_quote: On the other hand, the presence of persistent RPA-coated ssDNA filaments upon replication stress or stalled replication forks will lead to recruitment of the ATR-ATRIP (ATR-interacting protein) complex, activation of the ATR signaling pathway and DDR (4,5).
